attrChange.detailDesc:
changed from "Returns the ATM Main Menu as data: for each of the six function buttons the label shown beside it and the state the main state machine runs when it is pressed. Left side: None, Balance Inquiry, Return Card and Terminate. Right side: Deposit, Withdraw, Fast Cash $50. To change the menu, edit the Main Menu constant; the main state machine needs no change.
Error behaviour: error in is passed to error out unchanged; the menu is returned in every case." to "Returns the ATM Main Menu as data: for each of the six function buttons the label shown beside it and the state the main state machine runs when it is pressed. Left side: Fast Cash $100, Balance Inquiry, Return Card and Terminate. Right side: Deposit, Withdraw, Fast Cash $50. To change a label or to move an item to another button, edit the Main Menu constant; the main state machine needs no change for that. An item with a NEW action also needs a new item in ATM States.ctl and a case for it in the main state machine - an action without a case of its own runs the "None", Default case and does nothing.
Error behaviour: error in is passed to error out unchanged; the menu is returned in every case."
